query:
INSERT INTO toolbox_paint_images (id, prompt, revised_prompt, model, size, file_path, mime_type, size_bytes, created_at)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
               RETURNING id as "id!: Uuid",
                         prompt as "prompt!",
                         revised_prompt,
                         model as "model!",
                         size,
                         file_path as "file_path!",
                         mime_type as "mime_type!",
                         size_bytes as "size_bytes!",
                         created_at as "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
